feeds.title: FunkCity.net
feeds.description: FunkCity.net is dedicated to funk, jazz, and soul music and beyond. It features current shows in Atlanta and other cities and has visited and occasional commentary from musicians and friends. Friends and family have encouraged them to share their musical journey. Get into their blog and learn more about services, videos, upcoming shows, bands, venues, and more.

feeds.title: Soul & Jazz & Funk
feeds.description: Soul and Jazz and Funk is an independent soul news and reviews blog compiled by Charles Waring and Bill Buckley, two of the UK's most experienced and respected Soul music writers. It is about the soul in all its wonderful hues and offers refreshing coverage of the soulful ends of R and B, House and Jazz, and more genres. Check out their blog and learn more about the latest news, interviews, reviews, articles, and more.

feeds.title: New Funk Classic Master
feeds.description: The New Funk Classic Master blog is only to promote and spread the real classics and original funk throughout the world. Get into their blog and learn more about articles, news, videos, and more.

feeds.title: Funkatropolis
feeds.description: Funkatropolis blog is a heart-warming, foot-stamping, hip-shaking blend of electric blues, classic soul, vintage funk, and love. Go through their blog and learn more about articles, writers, musicians, videos, and more.

feeds.title: Funkatopia
feeds.description: The Funkatopia blog serves as a hub for all things funk. Funk concerts, funk album reviews, funk news, and all things funky. Take a walk through their blog and learn more about the latest funk news on funk musicians, reviews new funk CD releases, gives you all things funky, and more.

feeds.title: Soul Music
feeds.description: David Nathan is the creator of the Soul Music blog, which was launched in 1999, and the British Ambassador of Soul. Visit his blog and learn more about reviews, articles, products, interviews, videos, playlists, records, and more.

feeds.title: Funk N Play » Funk
feeds.description: Visit their blog and learn more about exclusive articles, media, interviews, reviews, news, and more. Funk N Play is a music magazine that features news on indie, funk, and rock n' roll music. This magazine is renowned for its in-depth coverage of the music industry. It offers web-exclusive articles, media, interviews, and reviews in addition to a significant amount of backend content.

feeds.title: Obscure Sound » Funk
feeds.description: Browse their blog and learn more about albums, playlists, interviews, news tracks, features, articles, and more. Obscure Sound is an indie music blog that Mike Mineo formed in February 2006 out of a love for finding new and emerging quality music. It aims to feature quality music, preferably from artists you've never heard of before. They provide streaming audio in addition to accompanying write-ups.

feeds.title: Decoded Magazine » Funk
feeds.description: Dive into their blog and learn more about electronic music, fashion, lifestyle, industry news, interviews, travel, food, breaking new emerging talent beyond the dance floor, and more. Decoded Magazine is a collective of professional recording artists, journalists, label owners, DJs, promoters, and underground music lovers. They provide ethical, provoking, and humorous content to a global audience.

feeds.description: Check out the Dereks Music blog and learn more about articles, videos, and more on music.

feeds.title: Funk Punk Lives Blog

She's dabbled in podcasting, photography, video, and graphic design as well. Browse her blog and learn more about music, articles, videos, and more.

He teaches music education, technology, theory, and songwriting at NYU, The New School, Montclair State University, and Western Illinois University.
